# OnPoint Pros

> Family-owned residential remodeler based in Allen, Texas, founded by Thu Vo and Dillon Hubbard. Primary service: full-tile primary bathroom remodels (tear-out and rebuild, custom tile showers, tub-to-shower conversions). Also drywall repair, interior painting and flooring installation. Fully insured. Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12396670433062033498. Current rating and count: https://bathroom.onpointprostx.com/api/reviews (cached for up to 24 hours). Phone: (469) 617-5235. Email: team@onpointprostx.com.

## Key facts
- Full bathroom remodels start at $20,000. Most full-tile primary bathrooms are $25,000 to $45,000 depending on scope and finishes. Every project receives its own fixed quote.
- Process: a planning call, then a paid Primary Bath Blueprint (an in-home design and layout session, usually $1,000, credited toward the remodel if you proceed), then a written fixed-price scope, then materials staged before demolition. An inquiry does not book or charge for a Blueprint.
- Shower waterproofing: a connected system behind the shower tile and under the shower floor. Every new tiled shower gets a documented 24-hour flood test before the floor tile is installed.
- Licensed master plumbers and licensed electricians. OnPoint Pros handles required permits and inspections, with expected fees itemized in the quote.
- 3-year written workmanship warranty on every full-tile bathroom remodel, covering installation-caused failures. Manufacturer warranties are separate and passed through.
- Drywall projects have a $1,000 minimum. Painting and flooring are quoted per project.
- Service area: Allen, Plano, Frisco and McKinney first, then Prosper, Celina, The Colony, Little Elm, Carrollton, Lewisville, Coppell, Richardson, Addison, Wylie, Murphy, Sachse, Rowlett and Garland.

## Secondary services
- [Drywall Repair](https://onpointprostx.com/services/drywall-repair.html): patches, texture matching, popcorn ceiling removal, water-damage repair; $1,000 minimum. City pages under https://onpointprostx.com/drywall/<city>.html.
- [Flooring Installation](https://onpointprostx.com/services/flooring.html): LVP, hardwood, tile, laminate, carpet. City pages under https://onpointprostx.com/flooring/<city>.html.
- [Interior Painting](https://onpointprostx.com/services/painting.html): whole-home repaints and cabinet refinishing. City pages under https://onpointprostx.com/painting/<city>.html.
- [Home Refresh](https://onpointprostx.com/services/home-refresh.html): drywall, paint, flooring and trim as one interior project.
